app.title: AI Council — multi-model deliberation
settings.title: Settings
settings.fx.enable: Show the star & planets trail effect
policy.help: Failure policy: what happens when a participant call fails. Skip ignores the node and moves on; pause holds the session until retry; ask user opens a decision panel where you retry, switch model, or drop the node.
raw.help: Checked: export raw output (skips sanitization). Unchecked: export the sanitized structured minutes. Keep it unchecked for sharing and archiving; check it to inspect raw model behaviour.
roster.judge.help: Independent Judge: the winning proposal is picked by a separate model, keeping referee and players apart. If no Judge is configured, auto_select is off, or the Judge call fails, you review and pick the proposal yourself.
new.title: Start a new council
new.question: Question
new.question.ph: Give your hardest question to the council…
new.hint: Files are read-only; attachments and model output enter prompts inside data zones only.
list.title: Sessions
list.help: A session is written by the version that created it and is not guaranteed to load in another version. Export anything you want to keep before upgrading (open the session, then Export).
list.empty: No sessions yet — start one above.
list.delete.confirm: Delete this session? Its event log and history will be removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
ask.failure.title: Node failed · your call
ask.select.title: Pick the lead proposal
ask.decision.title: Your decision is needed
keys.title: Model API keys
keys.desc: Saved to your local OS keyring (Windows Credential Manager) only, never echoed back. If an env var or .env already defines the same name, it takes precedence and is flagged here.
keys.delete.confirm: Delete this entry from the keyring?
keys.source.title: Current source
keys.shadowed: An env var with the same name takes precedence (the value was saved to the keyring).
keys.error.badname: Names may only contain letters, digits and underscores, and cannot start with a digit.
drift.note: Config changed — continuing with the previous config.
footer: Events go to the app data dir only; export downloads via the browser.
diag.title: Local CLI environment
diag.missing: not found (install via npm/pip and add to PATH)
updates.title: Model list updates
updates.enable: Keep the model list fresh while online
updates.help: While online, asks each vendor's own model-listing endpoint what it currently serves and fills the gaps automatically (thinking levels only where there is verifiable evidence). While off, the app talks to nothing but model endpoints — that promise holds literally.
updates.never: Never checked yet. Once enabled it also checks at start-up, or press Check now.
tune.title: Run tuning
tune.hint: Applied automatically and saved locally for every new council. Failure policy and export format apply to newly started councils; running ones keep the settings they started with.

roster.need_key: This model is not usable right now: add a key under Settings → API keys (or start a local service) and let the connection check in Settings pass before it shows up here.
